name: Timeless
source:
We all have fond memories of our family growing up. The smallest things in life can have the biggest impacts on who we are and who turn out to be when we grow.

Memories from our childhood shape the person we become, but it's not just good memories that change who you are, the bad ones can linger and linger in the back of your mind until there's nothing left

Will you guide our protagonist out of his rut of feeling miserable over a misunderstanding that happened, or will you fuel his depression and sadness?
